title: In-silico and In-vitro Investigation of Flavonoids and Alkaloids from Artocarpus heterophyllus, Tinospora cordifolia, and Glycosmis pentaphylla as Potential NF-kappaB Inhibitors in Oral Cancer.
authors: Gotsurve, Komal Nagesh; Das, Joyeeta; Kutre, Suraj; Teja, Parusu Kavya; Rathod, Rajeshwari; Chauthe, Siddheshwar K; Behera, Santosh Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和MD模拟筛选天然化合物对NF-kappaB1（转录因子）的抑制，涉及蛋白-DNA互作相关靶点，但核心是药物-蛋白结合而非TF-DNA结合机制，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: Oral cancer is a global health concern, particularly because of its aggressive tissue invasion and metastases, holding 16(th) position on occurrence among all carcinoma worldwide. The aberrated transcription factor NF-kappaB1 influences development and spread of oral cancer, making it a potential therapeutic target. This study investigated the therapeutic potential of a few natural compounds from Artocarpus heterophyllus, Tinospora cordifolia, and Glycosmis pentaphylla in the treatment of oral cancer. Two FDA-approved drugs (5-fluorouracil, Docetaxel) and 16 natural compounds, including Artocarpin, Artocarpanone, Cycloartocarpin from Artocarpus heterophyllus; Berberine, Hydrastine, Magnoflorine, Palmatine Chloride, Tetrahydropalmatine from Tinospora cordifolia; and 5-Hydroxyarborinine, 5-Hydroxynoracronycine, 1-Hydroxy-3-methoxy-10-methyl-9-acridone, Des-N-methylacronycine, Des-N-methylnoracronycine, Kokusagenine, Noracronycin, Skimmianine from Glycosmis pentaphylla were examined using in-silico techniques. Among the 16 natural compounds studied, Hydrastine shown the highest binding energy (-6.87 kcal/mol) against NF-kappaB1, surpassing all other drugs, including the standards 5-fluorouracil (-4.04 kcal/mol) and docetaxel (-2.4 kcal/mol). Further molecular dynamics simulations and in-vitro experiments verified Hydrastine's exceptional anti-cancer activity. The results of in-vitro were well-aligned with the findings of in-silico, revealing considerable cytotoxicity, apoptosis induction, and cell cycle arrest. The findings revealed natural compounds' potential as safer, more effective alternatives to current cancer therapeutics, opening up new avenues for oral cancer treatment.
abstract_zh: 口腔癌是一个全球性的健康问题，尤其因其侵袭性组织浸润和转移而备受关注，在全球所有癌症中发病率排名第16位。异常转录因子NF-kappaB1影响口腔癌的发生和发展，使其成为潜在的治疗靶点。本研究探讨了来自菠萝蜜（Artocarpus heterophyllus）、心叶青牛胆（Tinospora cordifolia）和五叶山小橘（Glycosmis pentaphylla）的几种天然化合物在口腔癌治疗中的潜在疗效。通过计算机模拟技术，研究了两款FDA批准的药物（5-氟尿嘧啶、多西他赛）和16种天然化合物，包括来自菠萝蜜的Artocarpin、Artocarpanone、Cycloartocarpin；来自心叶青牛胆的Berberine、Hydrastine、Magnoflorine、Palmatine Chloride、Tetrahydropalmatine；以及来自五叶山小橘的5-Hydroxyarborinine、5-Hydroxynoracronycine、1-Hydroxy-3-methoxy-10-methyl-9-acridone、Des-N-methylacronycine、Des-N-methylnoracronycine、Kokusagenine、Noracronycin、Skimmianine。在研究的16种天然化合物中，Hydrastine对NF-kappaB1表现出最高的结合能（-6.87 kcal/mol），超过了所有其他药物，包括标准药物5-氟尿嘧啶（-4.04 kcal/mol）和多西他赛（-2.4 kcal/mol）。进一步的分子动力学模拟和体外实验验证了Hydrastine卓越的抗癌活性。体外实验结果与计算机模拟结果高度一致，显示出显著的细胞毒性、凋亡诱导和细胞周期阻滞。研究结果表明，天然化合物作为当前癌症治疗更安全、更有效的替代方案具有潜力，为口腔癌治疗开辟了新途径。
